svg.title: What to Check When Wi-Fi Is Connected but There’s No Internet: Narrow It Down to the PC, Router, or ISP
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
What to Check When Wi-Fi Is Connected but There’s No
Internet: Narrow It Down to the PC, Router, or ISP
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-06
Check the same Wi-Fi with another
device
Connect a smartphone or another laptop to the
same Wi-Fi.
Check the troubleshooter and basic
settings
In Windows 11, first run the Network and
Internet troubleshooter in the Get Help app.
Forget the known network and reconnect
Go to Settings > Network & internet > Wi-Fi >
Manage known networks, select the network, and
click Forget.
Ping the default gateway
In an administrator Command Prompt, run ipconfig
and note the Default gateway address under the
current Wi-Fi entry.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
